residual_risks: The final suite deterministically covers: rejection of disabled and legacy HTTP Codex snapshots before replacement; physical-prefix alias lock contention; recorded unselected-client ownership with that CLI and skill unavailable; Claude replacement/deletion/unreadable rollback outcomes.

Client-state mutation tests occur at explicit fake-client command boundaries. They do not simulate an uncoordinated write in the narrow interval after rollback has compared a registration and before it removes it.
